title: Yellowed Smoky Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A briny and shaggy Turkish dish featuring lamb, peppers, and a smoky flavor, grilled to perfection in scallop shells, kosher-friendly and perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb, bell pepper, and onion onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to scallop shells and brush with lemon juice.
Return the skewers to the grill and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until slightly charred.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with minced garlic.
